verification: Source archive SHA256 and detached release signature verified before the reference local build. Establish upstream signing-key trust independently; a checksum alone is not publisher authentication.
scope: Only optional apx-pqc statically embeds libcrypto/default provider; no external provider/config files are required. The separate HTTPS helper dynamically uses compatible system OpenSSL and trust roots.
security_claims: Standard CMS ML-KEM-768/HKDF-SHA256/AES256-WRAP/AES256-GCM. Recipient trust is operator-pinned SPKI, not PQ certificate signatures, sender authentication, replay protection, forward secrecy or FIPS140 validation.
reproducibility: This pins the upstream source and reference options, not universal binary identity. Compilers/platforms/build options can produce different archives. No upstream source/library is downloaded by the Apodexis Makefile.
